metadata.description: There are a large number of people in the tribal community who have knowledge about wild medicinal herbs . These people treat many diseases with wild herbs. We met Shivnath in Bastar district of Chhattisgarh. Shivnath easily recognizes the medicinal herbs in the forest. He treats diseases like diabetes and asthma with these wild herbs. Apart from this, Shivnath is also an expert in fixing broken bones.
